source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6 ("Four contests in Fermanagh local government elections")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Irvinestown rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests, but six changes of personnel, five Unionist and one Anti-Partitionist. The Fermanagh Herald prints the nominations. Anti-Partitionist. Returned unopposed.
